name: cache
description: A status line entry under the prompt: a countdown until the prompt cache goes cold. Fork of Ray Amjad's cache-clock (renamed to keep the entry short) that also restarts the clock when a mod (cache-warmer) forks over the transcript; handoff off by default.

onWarning.title: When the cache is about to go cold
onWarning.description: What to do at the warning if you haven't replied. handoff: Claude writes a per-session HANDOFF-<id>.md. off: just the toast. To compact instead, use Claude Code's own idle compaction (2.1.299+).
